title: Missing moeb tool: Read (pre-authoring file inspection)
description: Used Read (Claude Code built-in) to inspect .github/workflows/release.yml before spec authoring. The moeb read_file tool was available and should have been used for this operation.
proposed_resolution: Use mcp__moeb__read_file for all file reads within the spec invocation, including pre-authoring file inspection.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
